$reason: A stop inside an ICU case: a `<span>` whose `tabindex` is interpolated, which Angular compiles to a binding and renders. The template parses, and the tree holds the case as an ICU with no element in it, so nothing here can read the span: it is read as a stop, the worst case, and fails point 1 as a widget the walk never reached does. Read as empty, as the first reading off the tree had it, the span passed; read off the scan's text, as the second did, its `tabindex` is the text `{{ limit() }}`, no number, and it passes again — as it did on the tag scan before either.
